title: fusion-stage-record
description: The cross-repo record contract (devops docs/plans/core-runbook-verbs.md, "The record"): what `scripts/stage/core-stack.ts record show` validates before it prints a stage record, and the only shape fusion-qa's src/core-record.ts is allowed to assume. The top-level `required` array is the drift guard devops#42 asks for: it is read with jq and asserted equal to `core-stack.ts record show --list-required-fields`, which walks the exact same RECORD_REQUIRED_FIELDS array `record show` enforces field-by-field. It intentionally lists dotted paths rather than only bare property names, so a field nested under `addresses`, `vault_addresses` or `ephemeral` is named unambiguously and the equality check is a flat array diff, not a recursive schema walk. The `properties` below still nest normally, and carry their own per-object `required` arrays, for validators that want to check shape rather than just the field list.

address.description: A non-zero, 0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM address (record_addr in core-stack.ts).

chain_id.description: The core stage chain id. record_show refuses any other value as record-wrong-chain.

core_sha.description: The 40-hex candidate commit the record was generated for.

min_delay.description: The TimelockController min delay, in seconds. Must be a positive integer.

ephemeral.description: The throwaway ceremony keys and Safe signer roster (2026-09-24 decision: staging is throwaway, no key outlives the run that minted it).

approver.description: Must equal the address of the safe_signers entry whose role is "approver" — the relayer every Safe call is sent from.

keystore_dir.description: Path to the ceremony's on-disk keystores. governance verify treats a missing/empty directory here as keys-discarded.

safe_signers.description: The real 2-of-3 Safe (#1474): one entry per role, each an address.
